title.en: Reading concrete pump integral piston φ205 with the section names of Heat pipe
title.zh: 用来源页《热管子》的章节名来读concrete pump integral piston φ205

description.en: Heat pipe provides the section names for concrete pump integral piston φ205. A φ205 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ205 as its piston.
description.zh: 《热管子》为concrete pump integral piston φ205提供章节名。φ205 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ205 写成自己的活塞。

h1.en: concrete pump integral piston φ205 without figures beyond the row, under Heat pipe
h1.zh: concrete pump integral piston φ205不超出已印行，标题来自《热管子》

directAnswer.en: concrete pump integral piston φ205 is restated below in Hebei Pinjin Machinery’s own catalogue words. The section order is the order of Heat pipe, and that page is not a second nameplate. A φ205 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ205 as its piston.
directAnswer.zh: concrete pump integral piston φ205下面用河北品锦机械目录里已经有的说法重述。章节次序来自《热管子》，那一页不是第二块铭牌。 φ205 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ205 写成自己的活塞。

body.en: Where the source outline says “History”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. The integral piston page lists φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250, sold per piece, as replacement parts rather than OEM parts of other brands. This note is only φ205. Rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane are printed on the split-piston page, not as a material for this integral row. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. φ205 is not on the split-piston list. Do not switch the order to a split set. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“历史”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 整体活塞页列出 φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250，按个供货，并写明是替换件，不是其他品牌原厂件。本文只写 φ205。橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯印在分体活塞页上，不是这一整体活塞行的材料。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。φ205 不在分体活塞清单里。不要改成订分体套件。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

heading.zh: 结构, 设计, 与构造

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “Structure, design, and construction” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write integral piston, φ205, and the quantity in pieces. Do not add a material the page does not print. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: “结构, 设计, 与构造”这几个字不是第二张数据表。若目录印过数据，下面引用的才是那一句。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明整体活塞、φ205 和个数。不要补上页面没有印的材料。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Types”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. A φ205 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ205 as its piston. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“类型”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 φ205 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ205 写成自己的活塞。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Heat transfer”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“来源章节：Heat transfer”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: Use “Temperature range” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose.
